title: Implement mock email service
description: Implement the mock email service that logs emails to the console and a local file instead of sending them. Used when EMAIL_MODE=mock (default).
acceptanceCriteria: send() logs the email to console with full payload
send() appends the email to public/mock-emails/{timestamp}.html
Returns EmailResult with mode='mock' and a generated messageId
Verify by calling send() and checking the log file

steps.details: Export class `MockEmailService implements EmailService`. Implement `send(payload)`: console.log the full payload. Create `public/mock-emails/` directory. Write payload.html to a file named `{timestamp}-{to}.html`. Return `{ success: true, messageId: 'mock-' + Date.now(), mode: 'mock' }`.

Call `new MockEmailService().send({ to: 'test@example.com', subject: 'Test', html: '

Hello

' })`. Verify console output and file in public/mock-emails/.
